headline: Nothing teases new AI device, CEO says it launches in December
summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei said on X that the company will launch its first AI device in December, more than a year after he announced plans for 'AI-native' devices. The Verge describes it as screen-free, while TechCrunch says it's not yet clear what kind of product the smartphone startup is building, beyond that it will leverage AI for productivity.
